name: Mixer-NeRF
definition: A 3D reconstruction method based on hybrid spatial feature information that addresses NeRF's loss of local information and blurry details by adding a hybrid spatial feature learning module (MLCA) before the MLP and a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) network module between sampling and inference layers.
summary: Mixer-NeRF is a neural radiance field architecture that improves detail by mixing spatial and channel features via an MLCA module and dynamically weighting them with an SE module.
